title: BespokePresentation
description: One project-local presentation that fulfils a classified customPresentation requirement. It exists because the Presentation Registry is not allowed to be a ceiling: where a failed visual review names a criterion no registered presentation can answer, the rework plan classifies the requirement, and this is the smallest thing that can then actually build it. It is deliberately a stylesheet and nothing else. A presentation that needed new markup would need new bindings, and new bindings move the composition — so CSS-only is what makes 'preserves PageSpec, SectionSpec and content provenance' true by construction rather than by inspection.

setId.description: The candidate set whose review classified the requirement.

planId.description: The rework plan that carries the classification. Lineage back to the failure, so a bespoke presentation can always answer 'which review asked for this?'.

scope.description: The only scope a fulfilment may claim. A bespoke presentation must not automatically become a registry component: promotion into the registry is a separate decision that needs repeated evidence across projects, and a lane that promoted on first use would turn one project's exception into every project's default.

status.description: A fulfilment starts awaiting review and cannot start anywhere else. The factory wrote it, so under AGENTS.md rule 17 the factory cannot pass it.

changeSet.description: Exactly which files this presentation owns. Anything outside is refused rather than merged, so a bespoke presentation cannot reach the composition, the compiled design system, the generated modules or the project's package manifest.

tokensUsed.description: Design tokens the declaration reads. Every one must be emitted by the project's compiled DesignSystemSpec; a bespoke presentation that invented its own colour would be a second design authority in one file.

composesAtMobile.description: A bespoke presentation must compose deliberately at a phone width rather than inherit the desktop arrangement narrowed. That is the requirement the classification recorded, and it is checkable.

review.description: The independent verdict. Null until someone who did not create this presentation has looked at it.

registryPromotion.description: Deliberately not a decision this lane can take. It records what would have to be true, so 'promote it' is a later conversation with evidence rather than an implicit consequence of building one.
